open_stamp.treatment: Didot italic overlay added in the edit, not a Veo plate

set_language: ONE persistent set: <period, room, materials, light>. Say 'same <place> <year> set' for continuity; never 'same DNA' in a prompt.
continuity_lock: Every scenery plate matches plate 02's set. Prefer start-frame I2V from the last KEEP plate. Camera moves only; no furniture reset.
explorer_lock: At most one plate in this part. Exactly one Explorer, on model (01_Character/CHARACTER_BIBLE.md): round gold glasses, teal long coat, finished hair. Attach 01_Character/05_Generation-References/hos-explorer-reference-v01.jpg.
forbidden: HARD REJECT: Orbit robot; photoreal; Ken Burns or still push; gore; lava drip / molten bead; underside lamp bulb or shade cup; unfinished flat cards; unfinished Explorer hair; DNA helix; readable text or logos in the plate; twin Explorer.
motion_lock: Real Veo camera and object motion on every plate. No freeze-pad, no loop. If Create fails, stop and log it in production-status.md.
quality_note: Flow Veo 3.1. Quality for fragile light (lamps, flasks, glows); Fast only for low-risk garnish. Mac Mini CDP benoats@googlemail.com (Ultra). One plate per FAIL cycle; after 2 same-framing FAILs change the framing.
always_fails: unfinished Explorer hair or melted face
notes: Plate UAT on continuous playback (start, middle, end), never from stills. Assemble rough only when every plate has passed.
